effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault (safeTransferFrom caller to vault in _deposit).
The vault mints shares to `receiver`; the count is computed from storage (share price, deposit fee) and rounded down.
A deposit fee set in storage (0 at init) is cut from the assets before shares are priced; reward fee shares are minted to the vault first.
The vault delegatecalls the connector to put the USDC into Euler; this moves vault funds, not signer funds.
formats.shown: "Deposit" with the USDC amount, a raw share ticker "kEulerUSDC" and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit shows share ticker "kEulerUSDC", but the vault token symbol is "keeyUSDC".
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.constants.vaultTicker = "kEulerUSDC", field 'Share ticker'. Constructor args of VaultBeaconProxy encode symbol "keeyUSDC" (6b65657955534443). Case 0 mined: shares minted to signer with symbol keeyUSDC, amount 3398879910.
findings.fix: Set vaultTicker to "keeyUSDC", the symbol the vault returns.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares the signer receives; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.deposit: (uint256 _shares, uint256 _depositFeeAmount) = _previewDeposit(assets, _newTotalAssets, totalSupply()); case 0 mined: 3398.879910 keeyUSDC to signer, no amount on screen.

findings.title: deposit intent "Deposit" names no asset, amount or vault.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} into Kiln Euler USDC vault".

cases.notes: USDC out amount shown exactly. Shares in: amount absent, and ticker shown as kEulerUSDC while the token is keeyUSDC.

effects: The vault mints exactly `shares` shares to `receiver`.
The signer pays USDC; the amount is computed by _previewMint from storage (share price, deposit fee, rounded up) and has no maximum in calldata.
A deposit fee set in storage is added on top of the raw asset value.
formats.shown: "Mint" with a raw "Deposit asset: USDC" ticker, the share amount and the share recipient.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves; the vault computes it with no cap.
findings.evidence: Vault.mint: (uint256 _assets, uint256 _depositFeeAmount) = _previewMint(shares, _newTotalAssets, _newTotalSupply); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, _assets, shares, ...). No max-assets parameter exists.

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" hides that the signer pays USDC; only a ticker field hints at it.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint intent "Mint"; field 'Deposit asset' format raw value $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker.
findings.fix: Change intent to "Deposit USDC for vault shares" and label the ticker field "Pay with".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns shares from `owner`; the count is computed from storage and rounded up, not shown.
If the caller is not `owner`, the caller spends owner's share allowance.
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`; the amount is the balance delta after the connector withdraws `assets`.
formats.shown: "Withdraw" with the exact USDC amount, the recipient and the owner.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many shares are burned from the owner.
findings.evidence: Vault.withdraw: uint256 _shares = _convertToShares(assets, Math.Rounding.Ceil, _accrueRewardFee(), totalSupply()); _burn(owner, shares) in _withdraw.

findings.title: withdraw intent "Withdraw" names no asset or amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` shares from `owner` (the signer in case 1).
If the caller is not `owner`, the caller spends owner's share allowance.
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`; the amount is computed from storage, with no minimum.
formats.shown: "Redeem" with the share amount (ticker kEulerUSDC), the recipient and the owner; the asset received is not named.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the recipient receives.
findings.evidence: Vault._withdraw: SafeERC20.safeTransfer(IERC20(asset()), receiver, ...). Descriptor redeem fields: shares, receiver, owner only. Case 1 mined: 1.027038 USDC in to signer; reader 'likely USDC, not stated'.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label":"Receive","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}, or intent "Redeem shares for USDC".

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDC amount received and has no minimum bound.
findings.evidence: Vault.redeem: uint256 _assets = _convertToAssets(shares, Math.Rounding.Floor, _newTotalAssets, _newTotalSupply); no min-assets parameter. Case 1: 1.027038 USDC received, not on screen.

findings.title: redeem shows shares as "kEulerUSDC", but the burned token's symbol is "keeyUSDC".
findings.evidence: Case 1 screen 'Shares to redeem' = "0.999764 kEulerUSDC"; mined effect symbol keeyUSDC, amount 999764 out. Constructor args symbol "keeyUSDC".
findings.fix: Correct vaultTicker to "keeyUSDC" so every rendering uses the real symbol.

cases.notes: Share burn amount right (ticker label differs from on-chain symbol). USDC received: asset inferred, amount missing.
